listing.name: Cyber Troopers Virtual-On Force — virtualon_pc (drakenabarion)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reports force boot, menus, matches and audio. Online play is unavailable. Full-game compatibility has not been established, and Portcove has not confirmed it. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS4 CUSA16156 VirtualOnMasterpiece collection folder; select Force component force. Requires decrypted eboot.bin/pjv3.elf/modules/assets; update/fingerprints unbound.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the shared VirtualOn AppImage or Windows ZIP, or build from source. Select your own collection folder and the force component in the launcher (BB_EXE=force).

warnings: The project reports force boot, menus, matches and audio. Online play is unavailable. Full-game compatibility has not been established, and Portcove has not confirmed it.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
